trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    g=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==3]
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    if not g or not p:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    p.sort()
    slope=1
    if len(p)>1:
        slope=1 if (p[-1][0]-p[0][0])*(p[-1][1]-p[0][1])>0 else -1
    if len(set(c for r,c in g))==1:
        col=g[0][1]
        closest=min(p,key=lambda t:abs(t[1]-col))
        dc=(1 if col>closest[1] else -1)*(abs(col-closest[1])-1)
        dr=dc*slope
    else:
        row=g[0][0]
        closest=min(p,key=lambda t:abs(t[0]-row))
        dr=(1 if row>closest[0] else -1)*(abs(row-closest[0])-1)
        dc=dr*slope
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in p:out[r][c]=0
    for r,c in p:
        if 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w:out[r+dr][c+dc]=2
    return out
